Theorem
[Bakry--Emery volume comparison (Theorem 27.41)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0043, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0045 1. ch27:27.41\group Volume growth

If $\Rc _f\ge 0$ and $|\nabla f|\le A$ on $B_O(r)$, then \[ \operatorname {Vol}_fB_O(r)\le \omega _n e^{-f(O)+Ar}r^n, \qquad \operatorname {Vol}B_O(r)\le \omega _ne^{-f(O)+Ar+C}r^n \] when $f\le C$ on the ball.
